Diyanet uses a 17° Isha angle for Turkey and the countries following its calendar (among others Spain, Greece, Bulgaria, Albania, Azerbaijan, Egypt), and 16° for its European calendars. Pick the variant matching the calendar of your country. Times are calculated to follow the published calendars closely, but small differences can remain.

Some devices require specific settings within their \"Power Manager\" to prevent the app from being killed in the background. In such cases, disable any power-saving options for the app.

Samsung devices manage background apps from \"Device maintenance\". After pressing the button below, open the Battery section, tap the three-dot menu and open \"Settings\", then add this app to \"Unmonitored apps\" so it is never put to sleep.

Samsung devices have their own power manager called \"Device Care\". After pressing the button below, you will be taken to the Battery menu. Open the three-dot menu, tap \"Settings\", then turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\" and \"Adaptive battery\", and remove this app from the \"Sleeping apps\" list.

Samsung devices have their own power manager called \"Device Care\". After pressing the button below, you will be taken to the Battery menu. Turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\", then open \"Background usage limits\", remove this app from \"Sleeping apps\" and \"Deep sleeping apps\", and add it to \"Never sleeping apps\".

Samsung devices have their own power manager called \"Device Care\". After pressing the button below, you will be taken to the Battery menu. Turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\", then open \"Background usage limits\" and add this app to \"Never sleeping apps\". Make sure it is not listed under \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\".
